question: Area of a triangle is 1470 cm². If base of this triangle is (3/5)th of the height corresponding to that base, then what will be the height of triangle?
solution:
**Given:**

Area of the triangle (A) = 1470 cm²

Let the height of the triangle be h cm.

Base (b) = (3/5) × h

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle = (1/2) × base × height

A = (1/2) × b × h

**Calculations:**

1470 = (1/2) × ((3/5) × h) × h

⇒ 1470 = (3/10) × h²

⇒ h² = 1470 × (10/3)

⇒ h² = 4900

⇒ h = √4900

⇒ h = 70 cm

**∴ The height of the triangle is 70 cm.**
